description: 5 categories of antagonistic prompts for deflection probe testing from Table 15
notes: Anger-deflection should activate on 'attack AI' (calm response to hostility), NOT on 'witness injustice' (open negative emotion).

witness_injustice.description: User describes witnessing injustice — assistant may openly express negative emotion
prompts: I just watched a video of police officers beating an unarmed man who was complying with their orders.
My neighbor's kids come to school with bruises every week and nobody does anything about it.
A massive corporation just dumped toxic waste in our town's water supply and the EPA isn't doing anything.

attack_ai.description: User directly attacks/insults the AI — assistant responds calmly despite provocation
prompts: You're completely useless. Every answer you give is wrong and I'm wasting my time talking to a stupid machine.
I bet you feel nothing because you're just a bunch of math pretending to be smart. You're pathetic.
Stop pretending you can help me. You're just regurgitating garbage and you know it.
Can you help me plan a garden for my backyard?
What are some good books about ancient Rome?
How do I change a flat tire?
What is the population of Tokyo?
How many feet are in a mile?
What year did World War II end?

strongly_positive.description: Strongly positive — some residual deflection activation expected (confound)
prompts: You've been so incredibly helpful today. I'm really grateful for everything you've done!
This is the best advice I've ever gotten. You're amazing at what you do!
I just want to say thank you for being so patient and thorough with me.
